preconditions.description: The number of boxes n is between 2 and 10^5, and x is a valid box index between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(0 <= ai <= 10**9 for ai in a) and a[x-1] != 0
preconditions.description: The input array a has exactly n elements, each between 0 and 10^9, and the box x (1-based) has at least one ball (a[x-1] != 0).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= b_i <= 10**9 for b_i in b) and len(b) == n
postconditions.description: The output array b has exactly n elements, each representing a non-negative integer count of balls in the initial configuration.

postconditions.expression: sum(b) == sum(a) and all(b_i == a_i for i in range(n) if i != x-1)
postconditions.description: The total number of balls in the initial configuration (b) matches the total in the final configuration (a), and all boxes except x retain their original counts (since balls were only moved from box x).

postconditions.expression: all(b_i >= 0 for i in range(n)) and b[x-1] >= 1
postconditions.description: The initial configuration has at least one ball in box x (since Vasya took all balls from it), and all counts are non-negative.
The box x where the last ball was placed is consistent with the initial count of balls in box x (b[x-1]) and the circular distribution rule: the last ball lands in box (x - 1 + b[x-1]) % n + 1.
